hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Suffix matching corresponds to prefix matching on reversed strings.

hints.title: Node Metadata
hints.text: At each node in a prefix tree of reversed words, cache the index of the best candidate word: shortest length first, then smallest index.

hints.title: Query Traversal
hints.text: Reverse each query string and walk down the tree. At the deepest matching node, return the cached best index.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: L_total: total character count across wordsContainer and wordsQuery
complexity.notes: Linear time with respect to the total length of all words.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise suffix comparisons take O(N * Q * L) time, causing timeouts.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(26 * L) trie nodes for O(L_query) lookups.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Reverse strings to transform suffix queries into standard prefix tree lookups.
